entities.name: Neva
entities.description: Human noblewoman of Eldraine, victim of the Wicked Slumber.

entities.name: Wicked Slumber
entities.description: Curse spreading across Eldraine after the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: Acting king who ordered victims placed in glass caskets.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: Planeswalker whose nightmares stalked Neva in the dream realm.

entities.name: Vantress
entities.description: Home of wizards who studied the slumber.

events.summary: Will Kenrith orders victims of the Slumber placed in glass caskets.
events.quote: acting king Will Kenrith ordered that victims of the curse be placed in glass caskets to protect them

events.summary: Ashiok's nightmares stalk Neva in the dream realm, and a spectral visitor saves her life.
events.quote: Neva was only able to fend off the nightmares due to the influence of a mysterious spectral visitor who saved her life.

events.summary: The curse is presumably broken by Kellan and Ashiok is defeated.
events.quote: She presumably awoke when the curse was broken by Kellan , and Ashiok was defeated.
